education_expenditure_row = df[df['Series Name'] == 'Adjusted savings: education expenditure (percentage of GNI)']
gdp_per_capita_row = df[df['Series Name'] == 'GNI per capita (constant 2015 USdollar)']

# Extract the values for these rows across the years
education_expenditure_values = education_expenditure_row.iloc[:, 4:].values.flatten()
gdp_per_capita_values = gdp_per_capita_row.iloc[:, 4:].values.flatten()

# Calculate the correlation coefficient
correlation = np.corrcoef(education_expenditure_values, gdp_per_capita_values)[0, 1]
correlation

# Check for missing values in the education expenditure and GDP per capita data

print("Missing values in GDP per capita:", gdp_per_capita_values.isna().sum())

# Convert to numeric if necessary
education_expenditure_values = pd.to_numeric(education_expenditure_values, errors='coerce')
gdp_per_capita_values = pd.to_numeric(gdp_per_capita_values, errors='coerce')

correlation = np.corrcoef(education_expenditure_values, gdp_per_capita_values)[0, 1]
correlation

import pandas as pd

# Convert the arrays to pandas Series
education_expenditure_series = pd.Series(education_expenditure_values)
gdp_per_capita_series = pd.Series(gdp_per_capita_values)

# Check for missing values
print("Missing values in education expenditure:", education_expenditure_series.isna().sum())
print("Missing values in GDP per capita:", gdp_per_capita_series.isna().sum())

# Drop missing values
education_expenditure_clean = education_expenditure_series.dropna()
gdp_per_capita_clean = gdp_per_capita_series.dropna()

correlation = np.corrcoef(education_expenditure_clean, gdp_per_capita_clean)[0, 1]
correlation
